name: Paper Planes
description: Folded paper darts flying in a loose flock, every plane trailing a dashed line, their headings swinging together across the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --k: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, @var(--k) 0 7%, transparent 7% 14%) 0% 60% / 34% 2.4% no-repeat; -webkit-transform: translate(@r(-12, 12)%, @r(-12, 12)%) rotate(@calc(@rn(-75, 35, 1.4) + @r(-12, 12))deg) scale(@r(0.85, 1.05)); transform: translate(@r(-12, 12)%, @r(-12, 12)%) rotate(@calc(@rn(-75, 35, 1.4) + @r(-12, 12))deg) scale(@r(0.85, 1.05)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(@var(--k)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--near); clip-path: @var(--near); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(@var(--k)); opacity: 0.55; -webkit-clip-path: @var(--far); clip-path: @var(--far); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --near: polygon(95% 45%, 6% 15%, 31% 54%); --far: polygon(95% 45%, 31% 54%, 16% 79%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
